overview: This Senate resolution names the Senators who will serve on two joint committees, which are panels made up of members of both the House and Senate. Mr. McConnell, Mrs. Fischer, Mr. Hagerty, Mr. Padilla, and Mr. Merkley are named to the Joint Committee on Printing, which oversees the Government Publishing Office. Mr. McConnell, Mrs. Fischer, Mrs. Hyde-Smith, Mr. Padilla, and Ms. Klobuchar are named to the Joint Committee on the Library, which oversees the Library of Congress and the art collection in the Capitol. The Senate agreed to it by unanimous consent on March 6, 2025.
for: Supporters say naming these members lets two long-standing oversight panels for congressional printing and the Library of Congress organize for the new Congress.
against: Critics say this is a routine housekeeping measure that only fills committee seats and doesn't change any law or spending.
